name: Dashboard API returns full JSON payload after rebuild

actions.comment: Fetched rather than navigated: /api/* needs a Bearer token and a plain browser navigation cannot send one, so navigating to /api/dashboard only ever yields 401. Same fix already applied in 01-dashboard.
actions.value: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/dashboard', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('kernel_auth_token') } }); document.title = r.ok ? 'api-ok ' + JSON.stringify(Object.keys(await r.json())) : 'api-fail ' + r.status; })(); true;

expect: The dashboard API should return the full JSON payload with generatedAt, kpis, and tasks
